target: acceptances 3+7 — hardened must fail loudly when the payload marker is ABSENT, never fall back to standard. Pinned against an empty marker dir rather than against the repo's current state: the original version encoded 'spec 005 is unbuilt' as a permanent truth and broke the moment it landed.
cmd: o=$(TRACKER_AGENTS_DIR="$PWD/no_such_agents" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/hardened.md" 2>&1); c=$?; n=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -ci "hardened review payload is not installed"); s=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -c "005"); f=$(printf "%s" "$o" | grep -cx "standard"); printf '{"c":%s,"msg":%s,"names005":%s,"fellback":%s}' "$c" "$n" "$s" "$f"
